values.condition: Ground-based median radial velocity from eight epochs reported by Boubert et al. (2019), described as far slower than the Gaia value.

evidence.quote: They observed Gaia DR2 5932173855446728064 (Gaia-HVSC15 see Table 1) at eight epochs with a ground-based telescope, ultimately obtaining a median velocity of -56.5 \pm 5.3 km/s for the source, which is far slower than the -614.3 \pm 2.5 km/s found by Gaia spectroscopy.
